Article.ArticleTitle: [Primary-progressive multiple sclerosis as an atypical demyelinating process].

Abstract.AbstractText: This article presents an overview of current data on primary-progressive multiple sclerosis (MS). In this aspect, the authors consider its characteristics in comparison to other MS forms as well as possible markers of the disease, criteria of diagnosis and therapeutic options in the present and the future times.
